cover.title: Protein trajectory
cover.lead: Start from your protein split, switch levers on and see how far they take you, lever by lever and year by year.

steps.label: Steps
steps.sideNote: All data in this demonstration is illustrative. This is not a production tool.

baseline.title: Starting point

levers.title: Levers

trajectory.overlapNote: Levers partly touch the same products: their effects do not add up.

trajectory.extensionNote: Beyond {year}: diffusion assumption, lever effects grow by {rate} a year.
trajectory.dutchSource: Pace observed in the Netherlands: {text} Source: {source}.
trajectory.splitTitle: Where the effect comes from in {year}
trajectory.splitNote: At 0% of stores, {x} remain: not everything depends on the stores.
trajectory.co2TitleLever: CO2 from {from} to {to}, lever by lever
trajectory.co2TitleTime: CO2 change year by year, against 2025
trajectory.co2Note: CO2 of the products in scope, farm to fork, in kilotonnes of CO2e: an order of magnitude.
trajectory.revTitleLever: Revenue from {from} to {to}, lever by lever
trajectory.revNote: Volumes × price per kilo, like for like, in millions of euros: an indicative change.

i2.tileCo2Up: A year. At central values, a slight increase: little meat replaced.
i2.tileCo2Down: A year. A fall: the meat replaced outweighs.
i2.yearNote: Difference to today's layout, in points. The dotted line is the other version.
i2.whatTitle: What I2 is and what it is compared with
i2.assumptionsIntro: These three assumptions are lever 12's in the trajectory: changing them here also changes the trajectory. The model's other values are set in the 'Register' tab.
i2.modelTitle: Protein split in {year}, step by step
i2.modelNote: Every line is computed live from the register. In tonnes unless stated.
i2.formula:
change (pp) = 100 × [ (R0 × T + dP) / (T + dP + dA) - R0 ]
dP = added plant-meat kg × protein density
dA = - displacement × dP + meat effect × neighbouring protein × live stores
i2.formulaNote: R0: starting split; T: protein in scope; dP: plant protein added; dA: animal protein change (negative when meat falls). Stores go live along an S-curve, quarter by quarter.
i2.marginFormula: Margin on the added plant meat, minus the margin lost on meat, minus the implementation cost.
i2.tornadoNote: One input at a time to its low then its high value, everything else central.
i2.carbonFormula: Emissions of the added plant meat, minus the emissions of the meat avoided (ADEME factors, farm to fork).
i2.effortHqOnceNote: Booked in {year}, the year before first shelf
i2.mcNote: {draws} draws, triangular on each input's low, central and high value (fixed seed). Median in bold, P10 and P90 below.
i2.histNote: Median {median}, central value {central}: the two differ when a range is lopsided.
i2.registerNote: Each slider changes the central value; the whole card recomputes. Draws stay within the low and high range.
i2.registerLegend: Tiers: P peer-reviewed, C company data, G government, I industry or NGO, R retailer report or press, J judgement, D derived.
i2.rgOff: Version A shown: the range build inputs have no effect.
i2.findingsNote: Conclusions only; numbers are in the cited records. Confidence is Altera's judgement.
i2.explorerNote: Higher tiers outrank lower ones when sources disagree. Click a record to expand it.
i2.retailersNote: 'None found' means the research found nothing, not that nothing exists.
i2.notHeldNote: Figures from earlier documents, corrected on reading the sources.
